standard_prerequisites.name: Henkin saturation extension
standard_prerequisites.use: FOL branch: extends Gamma to a saturated consistent superset Gamma'.

standard_prerequisites.name: Lindenbaum extension
standard_prerequisites.use: Extends Gamma' (or Gamma directly) to a complete consistent Gamma*.

standard_prerequisites.name: Truth Lemma for the term model
standard_prerequisites.use: No-identity case: M(Gamma*) satisfies exactly the sentences in Gamma*.

standard_prerequisites.name: Truth Lemma for the quotient model
standard_prerequisites.use: Identity case: the quotient of the term model by the approx relation satisfies exactly the sentences in Gamma*.

core_obligations: Statement (lines 1002-1007): every consistent set of sentences is satisfiable.

Composition (proof lines 1009-1032): in the FOL branch, Gamma' saturated consistent via lem:henkin; Gamma* complete consistent via lem:lindenbaum; Gamma* is saturated because for each formula A(x) it contains a sentence of the form exists x A(x) implies A(c); the Truth Lemma (no-identity version, or the quotient version when Gamma contains the identity symbol) gives a model satisfying exactly Gamma*, so every A in Gamma is satisfied.
Every step between the cited lemmas is carried in the span; nothing is delegated.
proof_roadmap: Extend Gamma to a saturated consistent set, then to a complete consistent Gamma*.
Verify saturation of Gamma* from the Henkin witnesses it contains.
Apply the Truth Lemma (with the identity case routed through the quotient model) and conclude satisfiability.
difficulty_reason: Completeness theorem (statement 1002-1007, proof 1009-1032): a composition argument - saturation via henkin, completion via lindenbaum, satisfaction via the Truth Lemma with the identity case routed through the quotient model; all glue carried in span. H2.
